Progressbar.summary: Progress bar control: fills a block between min and max according to value and draws a centered caption. Inherits from Control.

props.defaultWidth: Default width in pixels (90); used when width is not set explicitly
props.defaultHeight: Default height in pixels (20); used when height is not set explicitly
props.min: Lower bound of the progress range; default 0
props.max: Upper bound of the progress range; default 100
props.value: Current progress value; default 100, always clamped to min..max
props.reverse: When true, fills from the opposite end; default false
props.caption: Text shown in the center; default empty string
props.noFont: When true the caption is not drawn
props.OnChange: Event table invoked when the value changes, with arguments (newValue, oldValue)

Progressbar:New.desc: Creates the instance, initializes it from min/max and clamps value.

params.obj: Construction table (may contain width/height and other fields)

Progressbar:_Clamp.desc: Clamps a value to [min,max]; when min>max the reversed interval is used. (internal)

Progressbar:SetColor.desc: Parses the color arguments, merges them into color and invalidates when the color changed.

Progressbar:SetMinMax.desc: Sets min/max (converted with tonumber, invalid values fall back to 0/1) and re-clamps value.

Progressbar:SetValue.desc: Clamps and stores value; when it changes, optionally updates the caption, fires OnChange and invalidates.

params.setcaption: When true, also sets the caption to the new value

Progressbar:SetCaption.desc: Sets the centered text and invalidates when it changed.

Progressbar:DrawControl.desc: Draws the background and foreground fill blocks according to orientation/reverse and prints the caption in the center.

fileDesc: Single-value progress bar control: fills a horizontal or vertical block between min and max according to value and shows a centered caption.
